    • serverTomlReadsLiteralStringsAndSkipsUnreadableValues

      public static void serverTomlReadsLiteralStringsAndSkipsUnreadableValues(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      TomlConfig reads single-quoted literal strings, keeps quoted # and ], and falls back to the default for a value it cannot read. In game: on a Fabric server, write spawnExcludedMods = ['minecolonies', 'create'] and globalPercent = 5.0 into serverconfig/somegoogly-server.toml, run /reload, and check the log warns about globalPercent while both mods stay excluded.
